subject: Invoice download is failing
description: The customer cannot download the September invoice from the billing page. The download button shows a failed request after a few seconds.

conversation.message: I need the invoice today for finance closing, but the download keeps failing.
We are checking the billing export and will share a verified copy shortly.

subject: Password reset email not received
description: The customer requested a password reset twice but has not received any email. Spam and promotions folders were already checked.

conversation.message: I still cannot log in. The reset email never arrived even after waiting 20 minutes.
We triggered a fresh reset from the admin console and are verifying delivery with the mail provider.

subject: Team member cannot be invited
description: Inviting a new teammate fails with a generic error after the invite form is submitted. The email address is valid and unused.

conversation.message: Our new analyst needs access today. The invite button keeps failing.
We found a seat-limit check blocking the invite and are applying a workspace override.

subject: Mobile app notifications delayed
description: Push notifications on iOS arrive 10–15 minutes late. Android devices on the same account appear unaffected.

conversation.message: Mentions in the mobile app show up far too late. I missed two customer replies yesterday.

subject: CSV import mapping question
description: The customer wants to know how custom fields should be mapped when importing contacts from a CSV export of another tool.

conversation.message: Which columns should I use for company name and owner email during CSV import?
Map company to organization_name and owner email to owner_email. A sample file is attached in the help center.

subject: Resolved SLA report discrepancy
description: The weekly SLA report showed two resolved tickets as breached even though they were closed within the agreed window.

conversation.message: The SLA export marks TCK-1011 and TCK-1014 as breached, but both were resolved on time.
Timezone conversion in the report was off. We republished the report and the breach flags are cleared.
